runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text:
The passages cover several OMB memos, so "the memo" is ambiguous. The 180-day deadline appears in three of them.

**M-25-21 (April 2025):** Within 180 days of issuance, each agency must send OMB a plan for consistency with the memo, or a written statement that it does not use and does not expect to use covered AI, and post that document on its website. Consistent with Section 104( c) and ( d) of the AI in Government Act of 2020, within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, and every two years thereafter until 2036, each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AL The same provision requires agencies to revise their existing internal AI principles and guidelines so they match the memo. Agencies must also include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum.

**M-24-10 (March 2024):** The passages show the same 180-day compliance-plan requirement, with the same two-year cycle. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum or any update to this memorandum, each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly a plan to achieve consistency with the memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. The passages do not say whether M-25-21 replaces this requirement, so I can't tell from them which memo governs.

**M-25-22 (April 2025):** The consolidated action table lists a 180-day deadline for each agency to achieve full compliance with that memo's guidance. The OCR text is garbled, so I can only confirm it partly: Each agency Achieve full compliance with the 2(c) 180 days uidance of this memorandum.

The passages do not contain any other 180-day obligations for M-24-18.

answer.text:
Under OMB M-25-21, issued April 3, 2025, agencies must produce a compliance plan within 180 days. Each agency must send OMB either a plan for bringing its AI use into line with the memo, or a written determination that it does not use and does not expect to use covered AI. Each agency must submit to OMB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. The plan must also cover updates to existing internal AI guidance, and the same requirement recurs every two years through 2036 under the AI in Government Act of 2020. The passages do not state the exact calendar deadline.

**Correction to my earlier answer:** I said the passages did not show whether M-25-21 replaces M-24-10. They do. This memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Memorandum M-24-10, Advancing Governance, Innovation, and Risk Management for Agency Use of Artificial Intelligence. The 180-day obligations I described under M-24-10 are therefore superseded, and M-25-21 governs.
